mostWorthwhile.text: Holding the glass was the most worthwhile passage because it brought the skin, nerves and muscles together in a recognizable activity. The panels show why holding still requires active adjustment.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the supporting layer to the surface barrier was the least engaging step: the pieces clearly belonged together, so it offered little decision-making, although the cross-section helped explain their arrangement.

surprise.text: The connected surface cells still allowed water to escape; the added outer layer slowed that loss without stopping it completely.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary. The visible parts and results gave each combination a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would choose to continue if another chapter offered a similarly concrete situation to explain. The glass sequence connected the earlier constructions to an observable outcome, though several intermediate choices were predictable.
